summary: Explains that tags on include_tasks or include_role apply only to the include itself; with --tags mytag, the include runs and only inner tasks also tagged mytag run.
questions: Do tags on include_tasks apply to the tasks inside?
How do I tag an include_role?
Why are tasks inside my tagged include being skipped?

answer_card.title: Tags on includes
answer_card.answer_md:
Tags on an `include_*` apply **only to the include itself**. With `--tags mytag`, Ansible runs the include, then only the inner tasks also tagged `mytag`.

```yaml
- include_tasks: db.yml
  tags: db

- include_role:
    name: bar
  tags: [foo]   # not applied to tasks inside bar
```
